you_should_know.title: Dozens experiencing homelessness move to encampment on St. Paul's west side after closure at Pig's Eye Park
you_should_know.summary: An individual experiencing homelessness believes somewhere between 60 and 70 people moved to an encampment near Shepard Road and Randolph Avenue, along the Mississippi River on St. Paul's west side, after the city cleared a site at Pig's Eye Park on Wednesday.

you_should_know.title: MN wildfires: Authorities report continued containment progress as sections reopen to public
you_should_know.summary: Firefighters continue to battle the wildfires caused by the July Lightning Incident across northern Minnesota — several hours' drive north of Minneapolis — and neighboring Canada, where fires have burned a combined 73,585 acres.
